label: fix 2: shell-me
result:
I've fixed all 18 skeptic failures in `/Users/workingmyassof/satbank/spec/v2-upgrades/shell-me.md` and removed every class element. The file had none of these fixes yet, so there was nothing from an earlier fixer to keep. That is the only file I edited, and nothing is committed.

- **Classes are gone (decision 5).**
  - U27 is now a stub saying it was withdrawn, and task S2 is listed as removed.
  - Up next row 2 (`assignment`) became `contest`: a private contest the student joined through Compete's invite code or link, closing within 24 h. It reads `deps.part('compete','closing_soon')`, which returns nothing until Compete provides it.
  - The Class nav item, the `K` key, the phone Class cell, "Join or teach a class", class push reminders, the "their classes" avatar audience, the roster check, the role line, the Assigned part, the Assignment activity row, class reports, `FREEMAIL` and the `until` drill field are all removed.
  - Override 38 now deletes §7 whole. R4 is marked void. The three classroom items in the Rejected list became one line.
- **Scorecard.** Rows 1, 2, 4–6, 8–11, 13, 17 and 19–23 are rewritten. The three class and homework rows are merged into one row 34, "Not built here, out of scope by decision", and the rows after it are renumbered 35–38.
- **Sign-in (U19, new U19b).**
  - SMTP is now a launch requirement, and `/api/health` reports the mail mode. When mail is off, the Email tab says so and offers the other ways in instead of a code form.
  - Passkey autofill is fully specified: the options call on page load, the conditional request, a refresh before the 5-minute challenge expires, and a virtual-authenticator acceptance check.
  - New U19b adds "Continue with Google" behind `SATF_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`. Tokens are verified with `cryptography` against Google's published keys, and accounts are matched by verified email.
- **Saved means one thing.** A single `account.saved()` check covers passkey, verified email and Google. A saved learner's diagnostic results now return with no sign-up form.
- **New U29, two names.** Your name is private, any script, and not unique. The board name is public, follows Compete's rule, and is unique.
- **Photo (U22).** "Your photo" is stored only on the device, downscaled to 256px, never uploaded, and never shown on boards or the share view.
- **Target (U4).**
  - Me shows the 1600 total with both parts editable, from one `summary.goals` that Me, Today and Plan all read.
  - `need()` now includes the module-1 minimum (14 of 22 for targets above 580) and admits the model tops out at 780.
- **New students (U1, U5).** Up next starts with "Take a module · 22 q" and Sharpen. The diagnostic comes third, labelled as asking for name and email while that gate exists.
- **Device keys (U21).**
  - Saving no longer cuts other browsers off. For 14 days, any browser still holding the old code gets its own key on its next visit and shows in the devices list. "End the old code now" ends that early.
  - Shared-computer sessions now end on the server: after 15 idle minutes, or about 60 seconds after the last tab closes. A 5-minute heartbeat keeps a visible tab alive. New tabs get the session from an open tab.
- **Screen height (U26).**
  - Below 1100px tall, and on the rail, Up next and the Today card move whole to a new "Now strip" at the top of the page. Nothing is shrunk into a tooltip.
  - The sidebar heights were recalculated for 9 nav items, and the nav now stays on screen down to 480px tall.
  - Keyboard shortcuts is back in the menu's Display group, and Home and End jump to the first item and Sign out.
- **Other fixes.**
  - Reports accept 10 files: GIFs and videos up to 50 MB each, plus a built-in screen recorder (U3).
  - Words offers only SAT words and transitions (default both, `math` refused), gloss is dropped from Me, the Help coverage answer names R&W vocabulary, and the share view is titled "Dana's SAT progress".
  - The profile summary is keyed by subject (`subjects.math`), and achievement tiers are computed from the catalogue instead of hard-coded numbers.
  - The country can be picked right on the rank line or in Settings, and the privacy text now says no location is detected.
  - Quiet hours are editable and never block the reminder the student chose.
  - Question text is Small · Normal · Large in Settings.
- **Overrides and outside table.** Overrides 2–45 and the table rows for R1, R4, R11, R12, R15, R16, R17, R38, §2.5, §2.6, §2.8, §2.9 and §2.12 are updated to match.

Three calls of mine go beyond or against the skeptic's fixes:
- **Swap window.** The skeptic asked that the old code be refused as soon as the laptop that sat the diagnostic types its code. I kept it working for 14 days so browsers that shared it aren't locked out. During that window anyone holding the code can still act as the student and get a key, and each one shows in the devices list.
- **No revoke on page close.** For shared computers I didn't revoke the session when a page closes, because that event also fires on every normal page change. Instead, closing sets a 60-second grace. A tab reopened within that minute comes back signed in.
- **Now strip scrolls away.** The skeptic suggested a sticky strip. Mine scrolls with the page, and the section bar keeps an "Up next · Start" button once it is out of view.
